nom: Curology Dark Spot Corrector Serum with Niacinamide for Acne Marks

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the serum did not help with wrinkles or creases at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum helps reduce redness alongside age spots.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report their dark spots, age spots or acne marks gradually lightened over one to two bottles of consistent use; one reviewer, however, reports it did not fade her dark or uneven spots at all.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight, silky texture that absorbs without greasiness
Small pump bottle, a little goes a long way
Layers well with other treatments like adapalene or other Curology products

extraits.texte: Did not fade the dark spots or help with any uneven spots ,wrinkles or creases. Sadly

I will have to update on results. But upon first uses, I can say that it feels amazing on the skin. Super soft and silky texture, doesn't feel heavy, greasy or sticky. It has a medium consistency, off white color and a faint scent of maybe crayons or plastic idk but it's not strong and I had to really hold it up to my nose to even detect a scent. I felt no irritation, no burning or anything. Definitely think this would layer well with other products, it's just super lightweight. Excited to see results, the ingredients all seem amazing and fantastic for dark spots.

extraits.titre: Effective treatment for dark age spots!
extraits.texte: Love Curology! and this dark spot fade serum is no exception! It’s a great size, you only need one pump so I expect it will last a long time. It goes on smooth and absorbs quickly. Feels good on the skin and helps reduce both redness and age spots so they are not so noticeable and easier to cover to makeup.

This product works great. I’m on my second bottle of it and I can tell the difference in my skin tone . It’s not completely spot free yet but I can certainly tell that the area of concern has lightened up
Buy it. I struggled with the worst & most stubborn acne spots. Applying this consistently day and night helped me clear up my face for the summer. This is the product you need.

reserve: Only 8 reviews were available for this product and none state the reviewer's skin type, so this reading rests on a very small, narrow sample.
